title: helm: introduce tenant cost-presets and quant profiles in chart defaults
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Adds opinionated helm values for batching, KV cache warmup, and quantization profiles. Non-breaking; defaults are off for sensitive tenants.
description: Motivation: Provide curated, deployable helm defaults that encode cost-optimization best practices for Dedicated/Private installs. This PR adds a small, self-contained schema of 'costPresets' and 'quantProfiles' to the Redwood helm chart values so operators can opt into tenant-level batching/caching defaults, prefill warmup hooks, and safe quantization presets without manually editing templates. Scope: 1) values.yaml additions: costPresets and quantProfiles (namespaced presets for tenant and cluster). 2) templates/configmap-cost-presets.yaml to expose preset metadata to the operator API. 3) templates/job-warmup-prefill.yaml (optional hook) to run controlled KV-prefill jobs during node startup. 4) README and examples/tenants.md documenting how to pick presets and safe-rollback guidance. Non-goals: this PR does not change runtime heuristics or autoscaler logic; it only supplies shipable defaults and small bootstrap hooks. Checklist: - [x] Add costPresets schema to values and defaults - [x] Add quantProfiles with conservative presets (int8-compat, mixed16) - [x] Implement ConfigMap to surface presets to platform operators - [x] Add optional Kubernetes Job template for controlled warmup/prefill - [x] Add docs and example tenant values - [x] CI lint and unit helm template tests - [x] Manual dry-run on staging cluster Summary of changes: commits below include value files, two small template files, and docs. Testing: ran helm template against k8s 1.25 and 1.27, verified rendered manifests, executed a dry-run of the warmup job in staging (no resource leaks). Ran chart lint and basic schema validation. Rollout strategy: defaults are conservative and require explicit tenant opt-in; cluster admins can enable presets cluster-wide via values override. Links: linear/ENG-2145 cost-presets rollout, support ticket SUP-9821 tenant requests for default cache warmup. Notes for reviewers: focus on values schema ergonomics and safety of the optional warmup Job (must be opt-in). If we accept, chart will be referenced by the Dedicated installer as an available defaults bundle.

review_comments: Liam Chen: Good direction. A few safety questions: why is the warmup job a Job and not a preStop hook? Concerned about runaway prefill in multi-node events.
Maya Patel: Chose Job intentionally so ops can schedule with TTL and backoff; preStop runs per pod termination and risks duplicate prefill. Job is opt-in and scoped by nodeSelector/taints in values.
Rosa Bennett: Can we provide a knob for maximum total tokens prefetched per tenant (to bound egress/storage)?
Maya Patel: Added maxPrefillTokens to costPresets and documented limits; default is unset (safe).
Ethan Morales: CI flagged a lint on the ConfigMap name length; please shorten and rerun
Maya Patel: Fixed resource names, pushed a lint-only commit; CI now passes
